🖼️ GPT Image 2 Prompt Dataset
	

   

🖼️ The ultimate GPT Image 2 prompt dataset (5GB+). 15,000+ image generation prompts with full metadata and preview images. Truly open source: No login, no ads, no redirection. Just pure data for AI image creators.

This project is a massive collection of prompts used for OpenAI's GPT Image 2 model and the resulting generated images. The entire dataset exceeds 5GB and contains 15,000+ images, all structured into a comprehensive dataset.
